# Cloud modernization for the enterprise

## Cloud migration strategy and solutions from Deloitte and Informatica

Before making the transition from legacy Informatica PowerCenter systems to Informatica’s Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) platform, enterprises should develop a cloud migration strategy powered by artificial intelligence (AI). This strategic step can help organizations reduce costs, mitigate risk, and unlock powerful insights using customized cloud modernization solutions from Deloitte.

### AI-powered cloud data management solutions for the modern data enterprise

To mitigate risk and develop a comprehensive cloud migration strategy, Deloitte’s Migration Factory solutions take a phased approach guided by specialists with deep experience across Informatica IDMC platform offerings, including MDM SaaS, Axon/EDC, CDGC, and more. This helps enterprises:

#### Achieve cost savings

### Achieve cost savings

* Automation-led migration factory with Optimization Engine
* Advanced auto-scaling and auto-tuning
* Data transformation and ingestion capabilities

#### Enhance productivity gains

### Enhance productivity gains

* No-code/low-code  
  integration for most integration patterns
* Pre-built wizards and templates for hundreds of common patterns
* Dynamic pipelines for a “build once, deploy many” approach

#### Make operationalization improvements

### Make operationalization improvements

* Multi-cloud  
  and on-premises iPaaS capabilities for application modernization
* Market-leading data quality for advanced data integration tasks
* Cloud marketplace for data democratization
